needs_human.note: A stat failure other than a missing path keeps the pointer and counts as failed. This is the r1 proposal, but no spec section or revision states it, and the spec's section 3 list has no such outcome.; A pointer naming a directory or other non-regular file is kept at every startup and is never regenerated, while I10 says a row with no file and no slot has its pointer emptied (R2-MIG-1).; While a cache directory stays unsearchable, a row kept by the new branch answers 500 at GET /api/files/{id}/thumbnail instead of the placeholder. decisions.md records this as DIFFERS; the route has no diff, but at r1's head the same rows had an empty pointer and served the placeholder.; A scan-detected move of a row with an empty or dangling pointer defers generation to the next scan (r1 F-5). No ruling is recorded, and the spec's section 9 'after the first scan' does not state the delay.; Two rows naming one absent string form a shared group and are both emptied even if a slot exists, against I10's wording (claude-deep r1). I still found no ordinary way to reach this.

Migration keeps the pointer for a stat error or a non-regular file (thumbnail_migration.py:30-33, :82-87). r1 sent this question to a human, and no decision is recorded.; Purging a row whose pointer names a directory raises at fileops.py:641, because unlink is called on a directory, and the migration now keeps such pointers. No ordinary way to reach this was found.; An upload over a reused row whose commit fails leaves the slot already rewritten, since upload.py:361 removes the new slot only when there is no reused row. The spec states only the new-id case. The target file also stays on disk, so a later scan would match the picture for a .by-id row.

A stat error or non-file at a pointer now keeps it and counts as failed. The spec's state table and failure cases do not state this, and I10 reads the other way for a non-file (MIG-2).; Still undecided from r1: a scan-detected move of a row with an empty or dangling .by-id pointer does not generate until the next scan, because scanner.py:657-679 has no thumbnail step. This narrows I1's 'after the first scan' for a shared row renamed on disk before that scan.; Still undecided from r1: two rows naming one absent path string are both emptied at thumbnail_migration.py:88-93 even if a slot exists, whereas I10 repoints a row with a slot. I found no ordinary path to that state.; Still undecided from r1: with the old addon pin, Media Import's caption retry rewrites .loft rows to path form with a new mtime and ETag, so startups repeat the move during the delivery window (decisions.md first run, item 5).; A commit failure on upload over a reused row leaves the slot holding the new file's picture while the row rolls back. Spec section 2 defines only the new-id case.
